description: Yesterday, State Representative Paul Donato and I were proud to present 6 Malden Fire Firefighters with citations from the House of Representatives for their outstanding bravery above and beyond the call of duty to help our neighbors in Revere, and save a resident from an apartment fire. Thanks to Mayor Christenson for joining us to once again honor their service!

title: Honoring the Heroes of the Malden Fire Department
